newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES SEEN LOSING STEAM AFTER WED GAIN.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES SEEN LOSING STEAM AFTER WED GAIN.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to lose steam on Thursday after Wednesday's 1.6-percent gain followed by stronger selling after price-fixing and slight gains at continuous trade.

Analysts said the run-up to September's parliamentary elections should dampen buying in coming weeks but said gains by large-cap stocks and recent rises on neighbouring bourses suggested this week's growth might still have some upside.
On Thursday PLI transfers to the main market from the bourse's parallel floor.
